name: Threshold of Prayer
summary: A tall mosque gateway opens directly onto a broad prayer rug, joining the building and the act of prayer on one axis.
why: The pointed gateway, open doorway and rug all share x58. The left minaret is joined to the side hall. The rug overlaps the full two-unit threshold at y63 to65 and widens outward with exact mirrored edges, so it physically joins the entrance instead of sitting below as a separate accessory.
risk: The large gateway and rug make this more expressive than a minimal mosque mark. Its rug arch simplifies at small sizes.
key2: A rug extending from the threshold
sub2: A direct link to daily worship
reasonToChoose: You want prayer itself expressed through one connected entrance and rug.
